name: The Broken Lolipop
source:
Lala is a sad clown that is widely considered a misfit. While your meeting with her is a chance encounter, it will be a large deciding factor in her fate. With you be the helping hand she needs? Or will you be the final straw that gives her the drive to end her suffering once and for all? It all depends on how you treat her and what you learn about her.

[From [url=https://ornate-astrolabe.itch.io/the-broken-lolipop]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
拉拉是个忧伤的小丑，几乎人人都觉得她不合群。你和她不过是偶然相遇，这次相遇却足以左右她的命运。你会在她最需要的时候拉她一把，还是成为压垮她的最后一根稻草，让她决意永远结束自己的痛苦？这取决于你怎样待她，又愿意去了解一个怎样的她。

〔摘自[url=https://ornate-astrolabe.itch.io/the-broken-lolipop]itch.io[/url]〕
